instructions_to_main_agent: Create a brand new dedicated homepage component at `/app/frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.js` and mount it as the root route (`/`) in `/app/frontend/src/App.js`.
Ensure the existing `/admin` routes, `/login`, `/register`, `/widget`, `/chat`, and `/docs` routes remain fully functional.

Follow the exact color system: Background `#0B1020`, Elevated cards `#131D30`, Borders `#2A3850`, Primary text `#EDF3FF`, Secondary text `#A7B7D0`, Action Blue `#3B82F6`, Electric Blue `#83ADFF`, Cyan `#63E2EE`.
Use Lucide-react icons exclusively for channel badges, features, checkmarks, copy buttons, and actions.

Ensure all interactive buttons, tabs, toggles, form elements, and links have explicit `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `data-testid='hero-signup-btn'`, `data-testid='zendesk-mode-toggle'`, `data-testid='widget-color-picker'`).

Implement rich interactive previews: live interactive chat sandbox in hero, live widget color modifier with preview box, live Zendesk mode switcher, live knowledge base query simulator, and interactive embed code block with instant clipboard copy toast notification using `sonner`.
Use Recharts for the Dashboard preview section showing live trend graphs.
Do not use transparent header without backdrop blur. Sticky nav header must have `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B1020]/85 border-b border-[#2A3850]`.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: build crisp, polished, high-contrast dark UIs with precise pixel alignment.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate automated testing.
Use generous padding (`p-6` to `p-10`) inside cards to prevent border collisions.
Use sonner for toast notifications (e.g., when copying embed code or testing API connections).
Mobile-first responsive layout with proper breakpoints (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3`).
